profile.description: Pirate Fest did not move forward with Adventure Zone for 2026 because of budget and space limitations. Michael Ringling remains interested in working together in a future year. Keep 2026 as declined and retain one early-2027 relationship follow-up.

notes.subject: Pirate Fest 2026 declined / future interest
notes.body: On the August 28 follow-up call, Michael said Pirate Fest would not use Adventure Zone in 2026 because of budget and space limitations, but he wanted to work together in the future. Remove the incorrect signed-contract/confirmed-booking narrative. Keep one January 2027 reminder and ask about Pirate Fest 2027 and the possible July 4 standalone opportunity.

followUps.label: Reconnect with Michael Ringling for Pirate Fest 2027
followUps.reason: Pirate Fest passed for 2026 because of budget and space limitations, but Michael expressed interest in working with Adventure Zone in 2027. Ask about Pirate Fest 2027 and the possible July 4 standalone opportunity.
